system.description:
You have permanently rendered your vitae into a powerful organic acid — a last defense against diablerie and a lethal hazard to anyone who closes with you.

Any Blood Trait of yours that contacts something other than you inflicts two levels of aggravated damage to it, and anyone who drinks your vitae takes four aggravated levels per Blood Trait, making progeny and ghouls difficult to create. Each time a penetrating attack (stake, claws, blade, or a gunshot within five feet) wounds you in close combat, make a Simple Test; on a win you lose one Blood Trait that sprays at the attacker, who must win a Static Physical Challenge at a five-Trait difficulty or take one level of aggravated damage. Objects piercing you corrode on a Simple Test — wood ruined within five minutes on a win or tie, metal or plastic on a win — and a stake driven into your heart dissolves within five turns. Under Bloodform your blood dissolves only what you choose.
